findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest by default, risking exposure of sensitive report data.

findings.issue_category: no bucket ACL or public access block
findings.description: The bucket has no explicit ACL and no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource, leaving it without an explicit guardrail against accidental public exposure via bucket policy or ACL changes.
This bucket stores ledger export data but lacks a server_side_encryption_configuration block, meaning sensitive financial data is stored unencrypted at rest.
No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource is associated with this bucket holding financial ledger data, leaving no explicit guardrail against public exposure.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so model artifacts are stored without encryption at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is present, leaving operational runbook content (which may include sensitive operational details) unencrypted at rest.

This object is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.reports_archive, which has no server-side encryption configured, so the vendor roster file (potentially containing sensitive vendor/PII data) is stored unencrypted at rest.
